scientific_integrity: Self-contained infinite proof via alternating-track parity and a bijection of cyclic factor classes. Computational verification is corroborative, not proof by extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the regular paperfolding word and multiples of four at least eight. The starting values use independent finite enumeration with exhaustiveness certified against Allouche's known full factor count. No exhaustive literature novelty proof or independent audit.
title: Dyadic invariance of cyclic complexity in the regular paperfolding word
